sloka: प्राप्तम् उद्योग कालम् तु न अवैषि हरिपुंगव ।त्वम् प्रमत्त इति व्यक्तम् लक्ष्मणो अयम् इह आगतः ॥४-३२-१५॥
transliteration: prāptam udyoga kālam tu na avaiṣi haripuṁgava ।tvam pramatta iti vyaktam lakṣmaṇo ayam iha āgataḥ ॥4-32-15॥

translations.english: 'O chief of monkeys it is time for military expeditions. Since you are intoxicated you are not aware of this, Lakshmana has come here evidently for this.
